{{/* Alert Component - displays notification/message boxes with consistent styling Updated for Stratus Design System Parameters: - type (required): Alert type - "error", "success", "warning", "info" - message (required): Main message content - title (optional): Bold title text before message - id (optional): HTML id attribute for HTMX targeting - hidden (optional): Start hidden (default: false) - dismissible (optional): Show close button (default: false) - spinner (optional): Show loading spinner (default: false) - class (optional): Additional CSS classes Usage: {{template "vendor/partials/alert.html" (dict "type" "error" "message" "Something went wrong")}} {{template "vendor/partials/alert.html" (dict "type" "success" "title" "Success!" "message" "Operation completed" "id" "successMsg" "hidden" true)}} */}} {{/* Determine color classes based on type - Stratus semantic colors with dark mode */}} {{$colorClasses := "bg-cool-grey-50 dark:bg-dark-grey-800 border-cool-grey-300 dark:border-dark-grey-500 text-cool-grey-800 dark:text-cool-grey-200"}} {{$iconColor := "text-cool-grey-400"}} {{if eq .type "error"}} {{$colorClasses = "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30 border-red-300 dark:border-red-800 text-red-800 dark:text-red-300"}} {{$iconColor = "text-red-500 dark:text-red-400"}} {{else if eq .type "success"}} {{$colorClasses = "bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-900/30 border-green-400 dark:border-green-800 text-green-800 dark:text-green-300"}} {{$iconColor = "text-green-500 dark:text-green-400"}} {{else if eq .type "warning"}} {{/* Stratus uses orange for warnings */}} {{$colorClasses = "bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/30 border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800 text-orange-800 dark:text-orange-300"}} {{$iconColor = "text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400"}} {{else if eq .type "info"}} {{$colorClasses = "bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 border-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800 text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300"}} {{$iconColor = "text-blue-500 dark:text-blue-400"}} {{end}}
